section.content: The machine learning method comprises the following steps: distinguishing a foreground of the first image and a background of the first image to generate a first mask image; cropping the first image to generate a second image and a third image; clipping the first mask image to generate a second mask image and a third mask image, wherein the position of the second mask image and the position of the third mask image correspond to the position of the second image and the position of the third image respectively; generating a first characteristic vector group of the second image and a second characteristic vector group of the third image through the model; generating a first matrix according to the first characteristic vector group and the second characteristic vector group; generating a second matrix according to the second mask image and the third mask image; generating a function according to the first matrix and the second matrix; the model is adjusted according to the function. In this way, the foreground and background conditions are considered separately, so that the model performs better.

机器学习方法包括：区分第一影像的前景及第一影像的背景以产生第一遮罩影像；裁剪第一影像以产生第二影像及第三影像；裁剪第一遮罩影像以产生第二遮罩影像及第三遮罩影像，其中第二遮罩影像的位置及第三遮罩影像的位置分别对应第二影像的位置及第三影像的位置；通过模型，产生第二影像的第一特征向量组及第三影像的第二特征向量组；依据第一特征向量组及第二特征向量组产生第一矩阵；依据第二遮罩影像及第三遮罩影像产生第二矩阵；依据第一矩阵及第二矩阵产生函数；以及依据函数调整模型。如此一来，前景及背景的状况会被分开考虑，使得模型的表现较佳。

Machine learning methodTechnical Field

The present disclosure relates to machine learning, and more particularly to a machine learning method.

Background

During training of the model, images known to belong to the same class are input into the model to generate a loss function. Since the input images belong to the same class, the results of various downstream tasks of the model, such as classification results, can be improved by adjusting the model parameters to reduce the loss function. However, the foregoing method may not be able to distinguish the foreground from the background of the image, so that the training result is poor. Therefore, how to overcome the above-mentioned drawbacks is an important subject in the art.

Disclosure of Invention

The embodiment of the invention comprises a machine learning method. The machine learning method comprises the following steps: distinguishing a foreground of the first image and a background of the first image to generate a first mask image; cropping the first image to generate a second image and a third image; clipping the first mask image to generate a second mask image and a third mask image, wherein the position of the second mask image and the position of the third mask image correspond to the position of the second image and the position of the third image respectively; generating a first characteristic vector group of the second image and a second characteristic vector group of the third image through the model; generating a first matrix according to the first characteristic vector group and the second characteristic vector group; generating a second matrix according to the second mask image and the third mask image; generating a function according to the first matrix and the second matrix; the model is adjusted according to the function.

In some embodiments, the machine learning method further comprises: cropping each of the first image and the first mask image to generate a fourth image and a second mask image, wherein the position of the second mask image and the position of the fourth image are the same; cropping each of the first image and the first mask image to generate a fifth image and a third mask image, wherein the position of the third mask image and the position of the fifth image are the same; processing the fourth image to generate a second image; and processing the fifth image to generate a third image.

In some embodiments, the machine learning method further comprises: cropping each of the first image and the first mask image to generate a fourth image and a fourth mask image, wherein the position of the fourth mask image and the position of the fourth image are the same; generating a foreground rate of the fourth image according to the fourth mask image; when the foreground rate is greater than or equal to the preset foreground rate and the image size of the fourth image is greater than or equal to the preset size, selecting the fourth image and the fourth mask image as the second image and the second mask image; and when the foreground rate is smaller than the preset foreground rate or the image size of the fourth image is smaller than the preset size, cutting each of the first image and the first mask image again.

In some embodiments, generating the second matrix includes: generating a first portion of a second matrix in response to each of the foreground of the second mask image and the foreground of the third mask image; a second portion of the second matrix is generated in response to at least one of the background of the second mask image and the background of the third mask image, wherein each pixel in the first portion has a first logical value and each pixel in the second portion has a second logical value different from the first logical value.

In some embodiments, the machine learning method further comprises: extracting features of the second image to generate a first feature map set of the second image, each feature map in the first feature map set having a size; extracting features of the third image to generate a second feature map set of the third image, each feature map in the second feature map set having a size; resizing the second mask image to produce a fourth mask image having a size; resizing the third mask image to produce a fifth mask image having a size; and performing an operation on the fourth mask image and the fifth mask image to generate a second matrix.

In some embodiments, generating the function includes: according to the first positions of the first part, a corresponding first plurality of similarity values of the first matrix are selected as the third part, wherein the function decreases when the first similarity values of the third part increase.

In some embodiments, generating the function includes: and selecting a corresponding plurality of second similarity values of the first matrix as the fourth portion according to the plurality of second positions of the second portion, wherein the function increases when the second similarity values of the second portion increase.

The embodiment of the invention comprises a machine learning method. The machine learning method comprises the following steps: distinguishing a foreground of the first image and a background of the first image to generate a first mask image; cropping each of the first image and the first mask image to generate a second image and a second mask image, wherein the position of the second mask image and the position of the second image are the same; generating a foreground rate of the second image according to the second mask image, wherein the foreground rate is the foreground area of the second image divided by the image size of the second image; and generating a function at least according to the second mask image and the second image when the foreground rate is greater than or equal to the preset foreground rate and the image size of the second image is greater than or equal to the preset size so as to train the model.

In some embodiments, the machine learning method further comprises: cropping each of the first image and the first mask image to generate a third image and a third mask image, wherein the position of the third mask image and the position of the third image are the same; generating a first characteristic image group of the second image and a second characteristic image group of the third image through the model; generating a first characteristic vector group of the first characteristic image group and a second characteristic vector group of the second characteristic image group through a model; generating a first matrix according to the first characteristic vector group and the second characteristic vector group; generating a second matrix according to the second mask image and the third mask image; and generating a function according to the plurality of similarity values of the first matrix and the plurality of positions of the first portion of the second matrix, wherein the first portion corresponds to each of the foreground of the second mask image and the foreground of the third mask image.

In some embodiments, the machine learning method further comprises: generating a function according to the similarity values of the first matrix and the plurality of positions of the second portion of the second matrix, wherein the second portion corresponds to at least one of the background of the second mask image and the background of the third mask image, the function decreasing when a plurality of corresponding first portions in the similarity values increases, and the function increasing when a plurality of corresponding second portions in the similarity values increases.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a flow chart of a machine learning method according to some embodiments of the present disclosure.

FIG. 2 is a flowchart illustrating further details of the operations shown in FIG. 1, according to some embodiments of the present disclosure.

FIG. 3 is a flowchart illustrating further details of the operations shown in FIG. 1, according to some embodiments of the present disclosure.

FIG. 4 is a flow chart of a method according to some embodiments of the present disclosure.

FIG. 5 is a flowchart illustrating further details of the operations shown in FIG. 1, according to some embodiments of the present disclosure.

Detailed Description

Although the terms first, second, …, etc. may be used herein to describe various elements, this term is merely intended to distinguish between elements or operations described in the same technical terms. Unless the context clearly indicates otherwise, the terms are not specifically meant or implied to be order or cis-iental nor intended to be limiting.

Unless otherwise defined, all terms (including technical and scientific terms) used herein have the same meaning as commonly understood by one of ordinary skill in the art. It will be further understood that terms, such as those defined in commonly used dictionaries, should be interpreted as having a meaning that is consistent with their meaning in the context of the relevant art and the present disclosure and will not be interpreted in an idealized or overly formal sense unless expressly so defined herein.

The terminology used herein is for the purpose of describing particular embodiments only and is not intended to be limiting. As used herein, the singular forms "a", "an" and "the" are intended to include the plural forms as well as "at least one" unless the context clearly indicates otherwise. "or" means "and/or". As used herein, the term "and/or" includes any and all combinations of one or more of the associated listed items. It will be further understood that the terms "comprises" and/or "comprising," when used in this specification, specify the presence of stated features, regions, integers, steps, operations, elements, and/or components, but do not preclude the presence or addition of one or more other features, regions, integers, steps, operations, elements, components, and/or groups thereof.

In the following description, numerous specific details are set forth in order to provide a thorough understanding of the embodiments of the present invention. However, it should be understood that these practical details are not to be construed as limiting the present disclosure. That is, in some embodiments of the present disclosure, these practical details are unnecessary. In addition, for the sake of simplicity of the drawing, some of the conventional structures and elements are shown in the drawing in a simplified schematic manner.

Fig. 1 is a flow chart of a machine learning method 100 according to some embodiments of the present disclosure. In some embodiments, the machine learning method 100 processes the image OD11 at least through the model MD1 to generate a function LS1, and adjusts the model MD1 (e.g. updates parameters of the model MD1 and/or trains the model MD 1) according to the function LS1, so that the model MD1 can classify other images or perform other downstream tasks.

As shown in fig. 1, the machine learning method 100 includes operations OP11 to OP19. However, the embodiments of the present invention are not limited thereto. In different embodiments, the machine learning method 100 may also perform various combinations of some or all of the operations OP 11-OP 19 in various orders. In some embodiments, OP 11-OP 19 can be performed by a processor and/or memory.

In operation OP11, the mask generator M11 generates a mask image ODM11 according to the image OD 11. The mask image ODM11 includes a black portion BP11 and a white portion WP11. In some embodiments, the mask image ODM11 corresponds to a binary (binary) mask, and the black portion BP11 and the white portion WP11 have different logical values, respectively, for example, the logical value of the black portion BP11 is 0 and the logical value of the white portion WP11 is 1.

In some embodiments, the mask image ODM11 is used to distinguish the background and the foreground of the image OD 11. The black portion BP11 and the white portion WP11 correspond to the background and the foreground of the image OD11, respectively. For example, the image OD11 corresponds to an image of a dog on a lawn, where the image of the lawn is background and corresponds to the black portion BP11, and the image of the dog is foreground and corresponds to the white portion WP11.

In operation OP12, the expansion operation is performed on the image OD11 and the mask image ODM11 to generate images D11, D12 and mask images DM11, DM12, wherein the images D11 and D12 correspond to the mask images DM11 and DM12, respectively.

In some embodiments, the geometric expansion process of the image D11 and the mask image DM11 is the same, and the geometric expansion process of the image D12 and the mask image DM12 is the same. For example, the image D11 is the same as the mask image DM11 in position and size, and the image D12 is the same as the mask image DM12 in position and size. Details regarding operation OP12 are further described below in the embodiments regarding fig. 2 and 3.

In operation OP13, the images D11 and D12 are input into the model MD1 for processing. In some embodiments, model MD1 performs operations OP 141-OP 146 on images D11 and D12.

In operation OP141, the feature extractor F11 extracts features from the image D11 to generate a feature map group FMG1. In operation OP142, the feature extractor F12 extracts features from the image D12 to generate a feature map group FMG2. In some embodiments, feature extractors F11 and F12 may be considered the same feature extractor.

As shown in fig. 1, the feature map group FMG1 includes N1 feature maps FM1 (1) to FM1 (N1), and the feature map group FMG2 also includes N1 feature maps FM2 (1) to FM2 (N1). N1 corresponds to the number of features that each of feature extractors F11 and F12 can produce. In some embodiments, each of the feature maps FM1 (1) -FM 1 (N1) and FM2 (1) -FM 2 (N1) has N2N 2 pixels. N1 and N2 are positive integers.

In operation OP143, a convolution operation is performed on the feature map group FMG1. In operation OP144, a convolution operation is performed on the feature map group FMG2. In some embodiments, operations OP143 and OP144 may be implemented by a 1 x 1 convolution operation.

In operation OP145, a flattening operation is performed on the result of operation OP143 to generate the feature vector group FVG1. In operation OP146, the result of operation OP144 is flattened to produce the feature vector group FVG2.

As shown in FIG. 1, the feature vector group FVG1 includes (N2) 2 The vectors FV1 (1) to FV1 ((N2) 2 ). Wherein vectors FV1 (1) to FV1 ((N2) 2 ) Each corresponding to n2×n2 pixels of the feature map in the feature map group FMG1. Vectors FV1 (1) to FV1 ((N2) 2 ) Includes N3 components corresponding to N1 features. Wherein N3 refers to vectors FV1 (1) to FV1 ((N2) 2 ) The number of components of each of (a) is not shown in the figure. N3 is a positive integer. In various embodiments, N3 may be equal to N1 or may be different from N1.

Similarly, feature vector group FVG2 includes (N2) 2 Vectors FV2 (1) -FV 2 ((N2) 2 ). Wherein vectors FV2 (1) to FV2 ((N2) 2 ) Each corresponding to N2×n2 pixels of the feature map in the feature map group FMG2. Vectors FV2 (1) -FV 2 ((N2) 2 ) Includes N3 components corresponding to N1 features.

In operation OP15, the similarity matrix CM11 is generated according to the feature vector sets FVG1 and FVG2. The similarity matrix CM11 corresponds to the relevance of the feature vector group FVG1 and FVG2. In some embodiments, the feature vector sets FVG1 and FVG2 may be inner-product to generate the similarity matrix CM11. For example, vectors FV1 (i) and FV2 (j) are inner-integrated to produce the (i, j) th component of the similarity matrix CM11Where i and j are positive integers. In some embodiments, the similarity matrix CM11 has (N2) 2 ×(N2) 2 Similarity values of the individual components, and each similarity value represents (N2) of the feature map group FMG1 2 N1 features of a pixel of the plurality of pixels and feature map group FMG2 (N2) 2 Similarity between N1 features of a pixel of the pixels.

In operation OP161, the mask image DM11 is resized according to the size of the feature map in the feature map group FMG1 to generate a mask image DR11. Similarly, at operation OP162, mask image DM12 is resized according to the size of the feature map in feature map group FMG2 to generate mask image DR12. In some embodiments, the feature maps in feature map sets FMG1 and FMG2 are each of size n2×n2. Correspondingly, in operations OP161 and OP162, each of the mask images DM11 and DM12 is resized to n2×n2 to generate mask images DR11 and DR12. Details regarding the resizing are further described below in relation to the embodiment of fig. 4.

In operation OP171, a flattening operation is performed on the mask image DR11 to generate a vector V11. In operation OP172, a flattening operation is performed on the mask image DR12 to generate a vector V12. Details regarding the planarization operation are further described below in relation to the embodiment of fig. 4.

In operation OP18, a mask matrix CM12 is generated from the vectors V11 and V12. For example, the vectors V11 and V12 are subjected to an outer product operation to generate the mask matrix CM12. Details regarding the outer product operation are further described below in the embodiment of FIG. 4.

In operation OP19, a function LS1 is generated according to the similarity matrix CM11 and the mask matrix CM12. In some embodiments, the function LS1 is a loss function associated with the foreground and background of the images D11 and D12. Details regarding operation OP19 are further described below in connection with the embodiment of fig. 5.

In some embodiments, the lower the function LS1, the greater the probability that two images of the input model MD1 belong to the same class. During the training, images D11 and D12 for training are generated from the image OD 11. Therefore, the foreground of the images D11 and D12 should belong to the same category. Correspondingly, when training is performed by the images D11 and D12, the parameters of the model MD1 are adjusted so that the function LS1 is lowered.

In some implementations, when training a model with multiple extended images from the same image to reduce the loss function, the extended images are not considered to map the foreground or background so that the foreground and background may not be distinguishable. As such, the trained model performs poorly.

In comparison with the above, in the embodiment of the invention, the mask generator M11 divides the image OD11 into the foreground and the background to generate the mask image ODM11, generates the mask matrix CM12 corresponding to the correlation between each pixel and the foreground and the background according to the mask image ODM11, and generates the loss function LS1 according to the mask matrix CM12. In this way, when training the model MD1, the foreground and background conditions are considered separately, so that the model MD1 performs better.

Fig. 2 is a flowchart illustrating further details of the operation OP12 shown in fig. 1 according to some embodiments of the present disclosure. In some embodiments, the operation OP12 generates the images D21, D22 and the mask images DM21, DM22 according to the image OD21 and the mask image ODM 21. Referring to fig. 1 and 2, the images OD21, D22 and the mask images ODM21, DM22 are embodiments of the images OD11, D12 and the mask images ODM11, DM12, respectively. Therefore, a part of the description will not be repeated.

As shown in fig. 2, operations OP12 may include operations OP21 to OP26. In operation OP21, the image OD21 and the mask image ODM21 are stacked as the image group MG21. In operation OP22, cropping (Cropping) and geometric expansion operations are performed on the image group MG21 to generate the image group MG22. The image group MG22 includes an image DP21 and a mask image DM21. The image DP21 and the mask image DM21 correspond to each other and have the same clipping relationship and geometric relationship. For example, the position of the mask image DM21 in the mask image ODM21 is the same as the position of the image DP21 in the image OD 21.

Similarly, in operation OP23, cropping and geometric expansion operations are performed on the image group MG21 to generate the image group MG23. The image group MG23 includes an image DP22 and a mask image DM22. The image DP22 and the mask image DM22 correspond to each other and have the same clipping relationship and geometric relationship. For example, the position of the mask image DM22 in the mask image ODM21 is the same as the position of the image DP22 in the image OD 21. In some embodiments, the geometric expansion operation includes at least one of flipping and rotating.

In operation OP24, other types of expansion operations are performed on the image DP21 to generate the image D21. In operation OP25, other types of expansion operations are performed on the image DP22 to generate the image D22. In some embodiments, other types of augmentation operations include at least one of color distortion (color distortion), intermediate exposure (polarization), and auto contrast (auto contrast).

In operation OP26, the images D21 and D22 and the mask images DM21 and DM22 are outputted for subsequent operations. For example, the images D21 and D22 and the mask images DM21 and DM22 are output as the images D11 and D12 and the mask images DM11 and DM12 shown in fig. 1, respectively, to perform the operation OP13.

Fig. 3 is a flowchart illustrating further details of the operation OP12 shown in fig. 1 according to some embodiments of the present disclosure. As shown in fig. 3, the operations OP12 may include operations OP31 to OP32.

In operation OP31, the image group MG21 is cropped to generate a cropped image D30 and a cropped mask image DM30. The positions of the image D30 and the mask image DM30 are the same and have the same image size. Specifically, the image D30 and the mask image DM30 have the same coordinates, length, and width. In some embodiments, operation OP31 clips the random positions of image set MG21 to generate image D30 and mask image DM30. Correspondingly, the operation OP31 may be performed multiple times to generate multiple images D30 at different positions and multiple mask images DM30 at different positions.

In operation OP32, the foreground rate of the image D30 is determined according to the mask image DM30. In some embodiments, the foreground rate of the image D30 is the foreground area in the mask image DM30 divided by the image size of the mask image DM30. The image size is equal to the foreground area plus the background area.

In operation OP32, when the foreground rate of the image D30 is greater than or equal to the preset foreground rate (e.g., 0.3), the subsequent operations are performed on the image D30 and the mask image DM30. For example, the image D30 and the mask image DM30 are used as the image D21 and the mask image DM21 shown in fig. 2 to perform the operation OP24 to train the model MD 1. When the foreground rate of the image D30 is smaller than the preset foreground rate, the operation OP31 is performed again to generate a new image D30 and a mask image DM30, and the model MD1 is not trained by using the original image D30 and the mask image DM30.

In some embodiments, when the image size of the image D30 is smaller than the predetermined size (e.g., the length or width of the image D30 is smaller than 224 pixels), the operation OP31 is performed again to generate the image D30 and the mask image DM30 having the image size larger than or equal to the predetermined size.

In some embodiments, when the image size of the image D30 is smaller than the preset size or the foreground rate of the image D30 is smaller than the preset foreground rate, the operation OP31 is performed again, and the model MD1 is not trained by using the original image D30 and the mask image DM30. When the image size of the image D30 is greater than or equal to the preset size and the foreground rate of the image D30 is greater than or equal to the preset foreground rate, a subsequent operation is performed on the image D30 and the mask image DM30, for example, the image D30 and the mask image DM30 are selected as the image D11 and the mask image DM11 shown in fig. 1 to perform the operation OP13. In this way, the quality of the training image D30 and the mask image DM30 can be improved, so that the training result of the model MD1 is better.

Referring to fig. 3, each of images D31 and D32 is an embodiment of image D30, and each of mask images DM31 and DM32 is an embodiment of mask image DM30. The images D31 and D32 correspond to the mask images DM31 and DM32, respectively.

In some embodiments, the proportion of the white portion (foreground portion) of the mask image DM31 in the entire mask image DM31 is greater than or equal to the predetermined foreground rate. Correspondingly, subsequent operations, such as at least one of operations OP24 to OP26, may be performed on mask image DM31 and image D31 after operation OP32.

In some embodiments, the proportion of white portions (foreground portions) of the mask image DM32 in the entire mask image DM32 is less than a predetermined foreground rate. Correspondingly, after the operation OP32, the OP31 is performed again, and the subsequent operation is not performed on the mask image DM32 and the image D32.

Fig. 4 is a flow chart of a method 400 according to some embodiments of the present disclosure. In some embodiments, the method 400 is used to generate the correlation matrix CM41 masking the images DM41 and DM 42. In some embodiments, the method 400 may be performed by a processor and/or memory. As shown in fig. 4, method 400 includes operations OP 41-OP 43.

In operation OP41, mask images DM41 and DM42 are resized to generate mask images DR41 and DR42, respectively. As shown in fig. 4, the mask image DM41 includes a dot portion DP41 and a white portion DP42. The mask image DM42 includes a dot portion DP43 and a white portion DP44. The dot portions DP41 and DP43 correspond to the foreground and have a first logical value (hereinafter, a logical value of 1 is exemplified). The dot portions DP42 and DP44 correspond to the background and have a second logical value (hereinafter, a logical value of 0 is exemplified).

As shown in fig. 4, the mask image DR41 includes 3×3 pixels P41 to P49, and the mask image DR42 includes 3×3 pixels Q41 to Q49. On the other hand, the mask image DM41 includes 3×3 regions R411 to R419 divided by a broken line, and the mask image DM42 includes 3×3 regions R421 to R429 divided by a broken line. Pixels P41 to P49 correspond to regions R411 to R419, respectively, and pixels Q41 to Q49 correspond to regions R421 to R429, respectively.

In some embodiments, the logical values of the pixels P41-P49 and Q41-Q49 are determined according to the logical values of the pixels in the corresponding regions of the mask images DM41 and DM 42. For example, in the region R411, the proportion of the dot portion DP41 is greater than or equal to a preset proportion (for example, 50%). In other words, in the region R411, the proportion of the logical value 1 is greater than or equal to the preset proportion. Correspondingly, the pixel P41 has a logical value of 1. For another example, in the region R429, the proportion of the dot portion DP43 is smaller than the preset proportion. In other words, in the region R429, the proportion of the logical value 1 is smaller than the preset proportion. Correspondingly, pixel Q49 has a logical value of 0. In some embodiments, the proportion of the dot portion in a region is the number of pixels of the dot portion in the region divided by the total number of pixels of the region.

As shown in fig. 4, in the regions R411, R413, R416, R419, R423, R425, and R428, the ratio of the halftone dot portions is greater than or equal to the preset ratio. Correspondingly, pixels P41, P43, P46, P49, Q43, Q45, and Q48 have a logical value of 1. In the regions R412, R414, R415, R417, R418, R421, R422, R424, R426, R427, and R429, the ratio of the dot portions is smaller than a predetermined ratio. Correspondingly, pixels P42, P44, P45, P47, P48, Q41, Q42, Q44, Q46, Q47, and Q49 have a logical value of 0.

In operation OP42, the mask images DR41 and DR42 are flattened to generate vectors V41 and V42, respectively. The components of vector V41 correspond to the logical values of pixels P41-P49, respectively, and the components of vector V42 correspond to the logical values of pixels Q41-Q49, respectively. In other words, vector V41 may be represented as (1,0,1,0,0,1,0,0,1), and vector V42 may be represented as (0,0,1,0,1,0,0,1,0).

In operation OP43, matrix CM41 is generated according to vectors V41 and V42. In some embodiments, the vectors V41 and V42 are subjected to an outer product operation to generate the matrix CM41. The matrix CM41 includes columns C41 to C49. Columns C41-C49 correspond to the first through ninth components of vector V41, respectively, and nine values for each of columns C41-C49 correspond to the nine components of vector V42, respectively.

For example, in response to each of the second, four, five, seven, and eight components of vector V41 having a logical value of 0, nine values of each of columns C42, C44, C45, C47, and C48 have a logical value of 0. In response to each of the first, three, six, and nine components of vector V41 having a logical value of 1, the logical value of each of columns C41, C43, C46, and C49 is consistent with vector V42.

As shown in fig. 4, the matrix CM41 includes a dot portion CP41 having a logical value of 1 and a white portion CP42 having a logical value of 0. The dot portion CP41 represents each corresponding foreground of the corresponding regions of the mask images DM41 and DM 42. For example, in response to each of the regions R411 and R423 corresponding to the foreground, the pixels of the first column and the third row of the matrix CM41 have a logical value of 1 and are included in the dot portion CP41.

On the other hand, the white portion CP42 represents at least one of the corresponding areas of the mask images DM41 and DM42 corresponding to the background. For example, in response to each of the regions R412 and R424 corresponding to the background, the pixels of the fourth row of the second column of the matrix CM41 have a logical value of 0 and are included in the white portion CP42. For example, in response to regions R419 and R429 corresponding to foreground and background, respectively, the pixel of the ninth row of the ninth column of matrix CM41 has a logical value of 0 and is included in white portion CP42.

In summary, the dot portion CP41 indicates a case where the foreground of the images for training (for example, the images corresponding to the mask images DM41 and DM 42) correspond to each other, and the white portion CP42 indicates a case where the foreground of the images for training corresponds to the background or the background corresponds to each other. In training a base model (e.g., model MD 1), the foreground from the same image (e.g., dogs in image OD11 shown in fig. 1) is classified into the same category, rather than classifying the foreground and background of the same image (e.g., dogs and grasslands in image OD 11) into the same category, nor classifying the background into the foreground category. Therefore, the appropriate pixels in the image can be selected by the dot portion CP41 for training of the base model.

In some implementations, the foreground and background of the image are not distinguished when the base model is trained. However, the foreground and background in the image should not be classified into the same category. Therefore, the model training result is poor because the foreground and the background are not distinguished during training.

In comparison with the above, in the embodiment of the present invention, the mask images DM41 and DM42 can be marked according to the dot portion CP41 of the matrix CM41 and the foreground can be simultaneously corresponding to the mask images DM41 and DM42, and the foreground can be trained in the subsequent operations. In this way, the training result of the model MD1 is better.

Referring to fig. 1 and 4, a portion or all of the method 400 may be included in the machine learning method 100.
